items.title: Rufus Reid interviewed by Monk Rowe, Atlanta, GA, January 4, 2013
items.q: we are thankful to him that we got a chance to know he and JoAnn, because they made our whole lives change for the better.

ctx.x: Well it’s been fascinating. I thank you for joining me today.
Well thank you and of course you know our good friend Martin and JoAnn Krivin, you know they spoke about you writing the Foreword for the book. DR: You need to talk about Martin and you.
